stories.headline: Burials begin after stranding kills 24 whales
stories.text: 24 sperm whales died after stranding on Ninety Mile Beach in New Zealand's far north; burials were under way Friday.

stories.headline: Tonga declares a drought state of emergency
stories.text: Tonga declared a 27-day state of emergency as the El Niño drought gripping much of the Pacific worsens.

stories.headline: Storm-felled towers leave 20,000 without power
stories.text: Storms felled transmission towers on the Eyre Peninsula, cutting power to 20,000 people and closing schools.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall in Odisha
stories.text: Severe Cyclone Akvan crossed the coast near Gopalpur on Friday morning, winds gusting to 90 km/h, after 300,000 people were evacuated.

stories.headline: Asian shares slide toward worst week since 2020
stories.text: Asian stocks fell for a sixth straight day, the Nikkei down 4.1% and the KOSPI 4.7% intraday, toward their worst week since 2020.

stories.headline: Saudi defences destroy Houthi missile
stories.text: Saudi air defences destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile over the kingdom's south and intercepted drones near Jazan and Abha.

stories.headline: Russia's mass missile attack on Kyiv
stories.text: Russia launched Tu-160 bombers, ballistic missiles and drones at Ukraine overnight, setting fires across Kyiv from 1:25 a.m.

stories.headline: Climate talks' final day in Antalya: no deal
stories.text: The Antalya climate talks entered their scheduled final day deeply divided; a slimmed draft dropped every reference to fossil fuels.

stories.headline: Britain and EU set to agree trade reset
stories.text: Britain and the EU were set to agree a reset in Brussels, easing food trade checks and capping youth mobility at 100,000 people.

stories.headline: Pancreatic cancer pill's striking trial results
stories.text: Daraxonrasib plus chemo stopped pancreatic tumours growing in 90% of trial patients; in 1 in 12 they vanished.

stories.headline: Anthropic closes up 17% on debut
stories.text: Anthropic closed its first day at $97.17, up 17% from the $83 offer, after opening at $111.50 - a value near $1.3 trillion.

stories.headline: GTA VI's first day tops $2.3 billion in estimated sales
stories.text: GTA VI sold an estimated 24.58 million copies on day one for about $2.36 billion, nearly triple GTA V's debut - Sensor Tower estimates.
